title: Most of us in the entrepreneurial community are blessed·or c…

sents.en: Most of us in the entrepreneurial community are blessed·or cursed·with higher-than-average ambition.
sents.cn: 我们创业群体中的大多数人，都被——或者说被诅咒于——高于常人的雄心所眷顾。

sents.en: Ambitious people strongly desire accomplishments and are willing to take more risks and spend more effort to get them.
sents.cn: 雄心勃勃的人强烈渴望成就，并愿意为此承担更多风险、付出更多努力。

sents.en: Overall, this is a positive quality, especially for people trying to build their own businesses.
sents.cn: 总体而言，这是一种积极品质，尤其对那些试图自己创业的人而言。

sents.en: Apparently, if you're more naturally driven to set goals, you are more likely to succeed.
sents.cn: 显然，如果你天生更有动力去设定目标，你就更可能成功。

sents.en: Actually, this isn't always the case.
sents.cn: 事实上，情况并非总是如此。

sents.en: In fact, in some cases, extreme ambition may end up doing more harm than good.
sents.cn: 实际上，在某些情况下，极度的野心最终可能弊大于利。

sents.en: One major side effect of excessive ambition is the tendency to focus too determinedly on one particular vision or end goal.
sents.cn: 过度雄心的一个主要副作用，是过分执着于某个特定愿景或终极目标的倾向。

sents.en: This is problematic because it hinders your ability to adapt to new circumstances, which is vital if you want to be a successful entrepreneur.
sents.cn: 这有问题，因为它会妨碍你适应新环境的能力——而若想成为成功的创业者，这一点至关重要。

sents.en: If a new competitor emerges to threaten your business, you may need to change direction, even if that means straying from your original vision.
sents.cn: 如果新竞争对手出现、威胁到你的生意，你可能需要改变方向，即便那意味着偏离你最初的愿景。

sents.en: If you have too much ambition, you'll find this hard, if not impossible.
sents.cn: 如果你野心太大，你会发现这很难，甚至根本不可能。

sents.en: Few people are successful when they try to build their first brand.
sents.cn: 很少有人第一次尝试打造自己的品牌就能成功。

sents.en: Unfortunately, for the most ambitious entrepreneurs, a failure is seen as disastrous, and impossible to recover from.
sents.cn: 不幸的是，对那些最有雄心的创业者来说，失败被视为灾难性的，且无法从中恢复。

sents.en: It's a clear departure from the intended plan toward the intended goal.
sents.cn: 这清楚地偏离了通往既定目标的原计划。

sents.en: For people with limited ambition, however, failure is viewed as something closer to reality.
sents.cn: 然而，对于那些雄心有限的人，失败被视为更接近现实的东西。

sents.en: Remember, failure is inevitable, and every failure you survive is a learning experience.
sents.cn: 请记住，失败不可避免，而你挺过的每一次失败，都是一次学习经历。

sents.en: Ambitious people tend to be more materialistically successful than their non-ambitious counterparts.
sents.cn: 雄心勃勃的人往往在物质上比缺乏雄心的人更成功。

sents.en: However, they're only slightly happier than their less-ambitious counterparts, and tend to live significantly shorter lives.
sents.cn: 然而，他们的幸福感只比那些雄心较小的人略高一点，且往往寿命明显更短。

sents.en: This implies that even though ambitious people are more likely to achieve conventional "success," such success means nothing for their health and happiness·and if you don't have health and happiness, what else could possibly matter?
sents.cn: 这意味着，尽管雄心勃勃的人更可能取得世俗意义上的"成功"，但这种成功对他们的健康和幸福毫无意义——而如果没有健康和幸福，还有什么可能重要呢？

sents.en: Clearly, some amount of ambition is good for your motivation.
sents.cn: 显然，一定程度的雄心对激发动力有好处。

sents.en: Without any ambition, you wouldn't start your own business, set or achieve goals and get far in life.
sents.cn: 如果没有任何雄心，你就不会开创自己的事业、设定或实现目标，也无法在人生中走远。

sents.en: But an excess of ambition can also be dangerous, putting you at risk of burnout, stubbornness and even a shorter life.
sents.cn: 但过度的雄心也可能是危险的，让你面临倦怠、固执甚至更短寿命的风险。
